metadata.description: An independent verifier that can halt the job, plus a guild of 20 specialist agents. Measured across 12 models and 3 vendors: unprompted, not one run stated whether the work was blocked or whether its review was independent. With guildproof, every run did.

plugins.name: guildproof
plugins.description: An independent verifier that can halt a build, and a 20-agent specialist gallery. /orchestrate splits a multi-domain request across specialists and runs the verifier, which returns a blocking verdict. /sharpen turns a rough request into a complete prompt that names its assumptions instead of guessing. /lens reviews through expert lenses, or grades a prompt PASS/WEAK/FAIL with --grade. Eval-backed, including six known-bad fixtures the suite must always fail. Zero dependencies, no API keys, model-agnostic.
